text:
maria: Hey — customer is hitting a 422 and then getting all-zero scores from /v1/rerank. They send both top-level `query` and per-passage `query` fields. Sample payload below. Any ideas?

maria: ```json
{
  "query": "how to refund",
  "documents": [
    {
      "id": "d1",
      "title": "refund",
      "passages": [
        {"query": "refund steps", "text": "step 1"}
      ]
    }
  ],
  "candidates": [
    {"id": "d1", "text": "refund process"}
  ]
}
```

ken: Can you paste the exact 422 body and SDK version?

maria: 422 body is terse: "invalid candidates shape". SDK is js@2.1. Customer also has large passages arrays.

ashley: quick thought — our rerank expects a single top-level `query` string for scoring. If there are nested `query` keys in passages/docs the marshaller or parser can end up flattening/overwriting keys. That can mess up candidate->doc id mapping and lead to zeroed scores or vague 422s.

ken: Do we have a minimal repro we can run locally?

maria: Minimal repro pasted above — the passage-level `query` is intentional from the customer side (they tried to attach per-passage metadata).

ashley: That explains it. Parser/validator currently doesn't validate nested key collisions for `query`. When flattening for internal ranking, per-passage `query` can shadow top-level `query`. Result: scoring runs but uses wrong query context, and candidate ids may not match.

julien: I'll take this into eng. Short term we should: 1) add clear validation that rejects nested `query` fields with 400 + explanation, 2) add a doc note about allowed fields in passages/docs, 3) improve error text when id mapping fails.

maria: Workaround for customer: remove or rename per-passage `query` (e.g., `passage_query`) or move per-passage metadata under a `meta` object. That fixed their case.

ken: Creating a ticket now. @support-bot can you log CS-8421 with attachments (payload + 422 body)?

support-bot: Ticket CS-8421 created and assigned to eng-ml. Priority: P2. Attachments: payload.json, response.txt. :white_check_mark:

julien: Also uncovered another edge: if candidates array length >512 in certain runner configs we currently fall back to a fast path that returns zeros without a clear error. I'll add a guard and explicit 413/429 style error.

ashley: Good catch — please include a test for large candidate arrays and nested-field collisions.

maria: Thanks everyone — passing the workaround and ETA to the customer now.

ken: Follow-ups: eng will add validation + docs update; CS will keep the customer updated. :thumbsup:

julien: I'll post the validation PR number here when ready. :eyes:
